title: Optimization of physicochemical properties of theophylline by forming cocrystals with amino acids
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,40006-40017
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06804A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qi Li, Yifei Xie, Zhipeng Wang, Shuang Li, Shiying Yang, Dezhi Yang, Li Zhang, Guanhua Du, Yang Lu
This study presents the novel crystal structures of theophylline (THE) and amino acids (GABA and ARG). The solubility and permeability of THE in both novel cocrystals, THE-GABA and THE-ARG-2H2O, increased, especially in the latter.
